question: The President of India, Droupadi Murmu, was previously the Governor of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Droupadi Murmu** served as the **9th Governor of Jharkhand** from May 18, 2015, to July 12, 2021.
 
• She was the **first tribal woman** to be appointed as the Governor of Jharkhand since the state's formation in 2000.
